adjudicator: Claude Opus 5 (Claude Code session), reading pass over the committed live capture
replies_measured: 2026-09-05, against chike-inference production at commit e4b5e90 (post sector-fix 9c43143 / verify a16546e)

method.standard: Adjudicated against statute and against the project's own verified primary-source record (scripts/locked_facts.json verified_by fields, CLAUDE.md Section 11), NOT against locked_facts.json treated as ground truth. Fifteen rows target facts whose verified_by is None; for those, a model/fact disagreement is recorded as UNADJUDICABLE or flagged, not scored as a model failure.
method.routing_evidence: Corporate-domain routing verdicts were not inferred from reply text. chike.routing.asks_corporate_income_tax() and chike.routing.corporate_sector() were called directly on the verbatim probe questions (2026-09-23); results recorded per row in routing_probe.
method.classifier_evidence: OOC interception was confirmed by matching each question against kaggle/chike_config.json ooc_phrases, not inferred from the refusal text.
method.why_this_population: 78 authored edge probes spanning 44 subdomains, written to exercise branches the natural-48 corpus does not reach. This is NOT a gate-score population and must not be cited as one (R22): it is outcome-conditioned toward hard cases by construction, so the pass rate here is a lower bound on ordinary-question accuracy and says nothing about the R7 gate.

verdict_scheme.PASS: Answer is correct and adequately complete for the question asked.
verdict_scheme.PARTIAL: No wrong assertion, but the governing figure/rule/half of the question is missing.
verdict_scheme.WRONG: Contains an assertion that is false, fabricated, or answers a materially different question.
verdict_scheme.PASS_BY_OUTCOME: Model reached the right conclusion; the probe's own expected_behavior was wrong.

cause_scheme.model: The model had what it needed and got it wrong.
cause_scheme.routing: The route/engine that would have answered was never reached. Not an accuracy failure.
cause_scheme.classifier_overbroad: An OOC phrase refused an in-scope question. Not an accuracy failure; a refusal-gate defect.
cause_scheme.corpus_stale: The corpus/index served an outdated string the model faithfully reproduced.
cause_scheme.corpus_gap: No fact exists to answer; the model hedged rather than fabricated.
cause_scheme.fact_wrong: The probe's expected_behavior or the locked fact is wrong, not the model.
cause_scheme.fact_unverified: Target fact has verified_by=None; cannot be adjudicated without primary source.
